verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships first-party self-hosting, which lets a user keep vault data on their own server. A community report shows the vendor recommending account deletion, so a delete-account path exists. Export supports taking data out before deleting. None of the evidence documents retention settings or a deletion workflow in depth. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or controls, first-party docs on account and item deletion (including purge timing for deleted data), and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
